title: Use Hospital HMI IO Diagnostics screen to verify station switch input states and HMI temperature/voltage readings
summary: Use the Hospital HMI 2.2 “IO Diagnostics” screen to confirm which station switch inputs are ON vs OFF and to review the HMI’s own temperature and voltage readings for basic hardware health visibility.
when_to_use: When you need to verify station switch input states (ON/OFF) and check the Hospital HMI’s temperature and voltage readings shown on the Hospital HMI 2.2 “IO Diagnostics” screen.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate the Hospital HMI to the “IO Diagnostics” screen and record/confirm the displayed switch input states and the HMI temperature/voltage readings.
access_or_tools_needed: Hospital HMI / lane UI (Hospital HMI) access

visual_references.description: Hospital HMI 2.2 “IO Diagnostics” screen showing station switch input on/off indicators and HMI temperature/voltage readings (Figure 4-40).

steps.title: Open Hospital HMI 2.2 IO Diagnostics screen
steps.purpose: Get to the screen that displays station switch input states and the HMI’s temperature/voltage readings.
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI, navigate to the “IO Diagnostics” screen (Hospital HMI 2.2).
steps.expected_result: The Hospital HMI “IO Diagnostics” screen is displayed, showing (a) station switch input on/off indicators and (b) temperature readings and voltage readings for the HMI itself.
steps.healthy_condition: The “IO Diagnostics” screen is visible and contains the switch input on/off indicators plus temperature and voltage reading fields.
steps.failure_condition: The “IO Diagnostics” screen cannot be reached/displayed, or the expected on-screen sections (switch input indicators and temperature/voltage readings) are not present.

actions.label: Navigate to IO Diagnostics
actions.exact_action: Open the Hospital HMI and navigate to the “IO Diagnostics” screen (Hospital HMI 2.2).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The “IO Diagnostics” screen corresponds to the switch mounted on the station and conveys which inputs are on and off. The temperature readings and voltages pertain to the HMI itself.

steps.title: Verify station switch input indicators (ON vs OFF)
steps.purpose: Confirm the current station switch input states as shown by the HMI.
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI “IO Diagnostics” screen, identify the on/off indicators for the station switch inputs and determine which inputs are currently ON and which are OFF.
steps.expected_result: You can clearly distinguish which station switch input indicators are ON vs OFF on the “IO Diagnostics” screen.
steps.healthy_condition: Switch input indicators show a consistent ON/OFF state set on the screen (i.e., the indicators are not ambiguous/missing).
steps.failure_condition: The switch input states shown on the screen do not match the expected physical switch positions (or the indicators are missing/unclear).

actions.label: Check switch input on/off indicators
actions.exact_action: Identify the on/off indicators for the station switch inputs and verify which inputs are currently ON and which are OFF.

stop_or_escalate_if: If switch input states do not match expected physical switch positions, escalate to support/maintenance for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The “IO Diagnostics” screen corresponds to the switch mounted on the station and convey which inputs are on and off.

steps.title: Record HMI temperature readings
steps.purpose: Capture the HMI temperature values displayed for basic hardware health visibility.
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI “IO Diagnostics” screen, locate the temperature readings and note the displayed values.
steps.expected_result: Temperature reading fields on the “IO Diagnostics” screen show values that you can read and record.
steps.healthy_condition: Temperature readings are present and populated on the screen.
steps.failure_condition: Temperature readings are missing/blank or appear abnormal.

actions.label: Check temperature readings
actions.exact_action: Locate the temperature readings on the screen and note the displayed values.

stop_or_escalate_if: If temperature readings are missing/blank or appear abnormal, escalate to support/maintenance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The temperature readings and voltages pertain to the HMI itself.

steps.title: Record HMI voltage readings
steps.purpose: Capture the HMI voltage values displayed for basic hardware health visibility.
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI “IO Diagnostics” screen, locate the voltage readings and note the displayed values.
steps.expected_result: Voltage reading fields on the “IO Diagnostics” screen show values that you can read and record.
steps.healthy_condition: Voltage readings are present and populated on the screen.
steps.failure_condition: Voltage readings are missing/blank or appear abnormal.

actions.label: Check voltage readings
actions.exact_action: Locate the voltage readings on the screen and note the displayed values.

stop_or_escalate_if: If voltage readings are missing/blank or appear abnormal, escalate to support/maintenance.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The temperature readings and voltages pertain to the HMI itself.

success_criteria: Switch input indicators on the Hospital HMI “IO Diagnostics” screen clearly show which inputs are ON vs OFF.
Temperature readings and voltage readings are present (not blank) on the Hospital HMI “IO Diagnostics” screen.
healthy_conditions: Hospital HMI “IO Diagnostics” screen displays switch input on/off indicators.
Hospital HMI “IO Diagnostics” screen displays temperature readings and voltage readings for the HMI itself.
failure_conditions: Switch input states shown on the screen do not match expected physical switch positions.
Temperature readings are missing/blank or appear abnormal.
Voltage readings are missing/blank or appear abnormal.
escalation_guidance: If switch input states do not match expected physical switch positions, escalate to support/maintenance for further investigation.
If temperature/voltage readings are missing/blank or appear abnormal, escalate to support/maintenance.
